scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF/3D route comparison and refine implementation readiness for the planned MLINESTYLE output slice.

method.kind: Static primary-specification, project-source, release/documentation, and local-code review
method.evidenceRule: Source/specification and peer reports identify field and route risks only. A route qualifies only for the exact stage exercised; separate typed values, opaque carrier replay, object graph closure, semantic geometry, and native acceptance.

evidence: Autodesk's DXF object table documents fill and per-element colors as group 62 indexed colors and linetypes as group 6 names.
ODA DWG v5.4.1 section 20.4.73 defines the fill and each segment color as CMC, with pre-R2018 signed linetype indices and R2018+ hard-pointer linetype handles.

The local parser receives but discards top-level fill RGB/name/book results; element color retains ACI and optional RGB but discards color name/book. The DWG encoder writes fill ACI-only and cannot reproduce discarded color-book fields.
findings.disposition: The current typed model cannot prove lossless DWG-origin MLINESTYLE output for every CMC form. Keep raw DXF replay separate. Extend the model and prove a target mapping, or fail the typed output before publication for present unrepresentable values; do not approximate true color to ACI.

evidence: ODA places the linetype handle form at R2018+ and signed index form before R2018.

LibreDWG source maps observed indices 0, 32767 and 32766 to CONTINUOUS, BYLAYER and BYBLOCK and resolves positive indices against LTYPE control entries; its downgrade path itself notes incomplete lookup behavior.
LibreDWG NEWS records a prior union-aliasing bug in which the index and handle forms overwrote each other.
findings.disposition: Keep the model fields distinct and test both version branches. Treat sentinel values as peer-observed differential behavior to validate for the accepted source profile, not as a substitute for ODA's version layout or local evidence.

findings.topic: Broader DXF/3D peer and consumer boundaries
evidence: ezdxf documents SAT/SAB inspection and raw export, but its drawing add-on does not render ACIS and has no 3D rendering engine.
The reviewed FreeCAD DXF importer documentation says stock import cannot consume the proprietary ACIS blob.
IxMilia.Dxf exposes modeler entity types but warns that some 3DSOLID/BODY/REGION writer outputs may not open in AutoCAD.
ACadSharp issue 1195 is a release-scoped report of silent modeler-entity omission; it is not a current-release runtime result.
findings.disposition: These sources reinforce route-specific evidence and exact consumer reopening. No typed API, raw payload browser, entity count, or peer report closes semantic B-rep or native acceptance.
